acceptance_check1_world0_small_passive.verdict: check 1 as written (B0 < B1 < B2 < B3 < B5, every gap >= 3 paired SE) PASSES at the small passive budget under the pooled ratio at all three allocations (min z 4.5); it fails under EXAM's equal-weight mean (oracle - B3 z <= 0.96), at the large budgets (B3 - B2 z <= 1.1) and at small active (B1 < B0). It passes only because B0 (-0.78) is far below climatology while B1 is not above it (-0.07 +- 0.04).

pooled_ratio_cell_weights_n128.source: results/d2_scores.npz (checker), denominators S_clim - S_oracle per valid cell
pooled_ratio_cell_weights_n128.consequence: the pooled ratio is ~87% a level-1 h<=4 score; theta-sensitive long horizons get 3%. World 0 n128: ctrl_prior_mean 0.826 pooled vs 0.337 equal-weight; B3 0.942 vs 0.974

theta_headroom_pooled_per_world.reading: theta is worth 0.02-0.12 pooled OES (prior-mean control vs B3). The item history closes 0-48% of that gap; the large budget closes all of it (B2 within 0.002 of B3 in every world); the small budget is in between in worlds 0 and 2 (not in world 1). Check 4's letter (B2 between B1 and B3; more budget closes part of the gap) holds; its intent (B2 near the middle) fails because the headroom is small, not because 16-tick histories identify theta
